name: zaip-aios-plugin
description: Company memory and local workflows for development, design, marketing, sales, growth, operations and business decisions.

interface.longDescription: Choose one of six teams to start with, or set up all six at your own pace. Selecting teams configures their named ZAIP subagents in your project. Keep company facts, current plans, reports and approved assets organized by area. Look up the original file and check its intended use. Reconcile Markdown and Word during a task and compare their content. Use 203 skills and 23 specialist perspectives to plan campaigns, measure growth, develop software and run operations with the connections available in your client.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose a team and set up this project for my company.
Find our current campaign plan and the photo approved for this channel.
Check what changed in the sales playbook and reconcile Word and Markdown.

pt-BR.subtitle: Projetos, marketing e métricas
pt-BR.description: Escolha uma das seis equipes para começar ou configure todas no seu ritmo. Escolher as equipes já configura os subagentes delas com os nomes completos do ZAIP neste projeto. Guarde por área os dados da empresa, planos, relatórios e materiais vigentes. Encontre o arquivo original e confira seu uso permitido. Compare o conteúdo dos documentos Word e Markdown e concilie as edições durante a tarefa. Use 203 skills e a perspectiva de 23 especialistas para conduzir campanhas, medir growth, desenvolver software e organizar operações com as conexões disponíveis no seu cliente.
